heading: IN 1921, THE MOST PROSPEROUS [BLACK NEIGHBOURHOOD](orange) IN AMERICA WAS [BURNED TO THE GROUND](red). [AIRCRAFT](red) WERE USED.
body: On **May 31–June 1, 1921**, a white mob [attacked and burned Greenwood District](red) — known as **"Black Wall Street"** — in [Tulsa, Oklahoma](orange). The district had over **300 Black-owned businesses**. [An estimated 300 people were killed](red). **35 blocks** were destroyed. [Oklahoma National Guard](orange) aircraft flew over the neighbourhood — [survivors reported being shot at from the air](red), though official accounts vary. **$1.8 million in property** was destroyed. No convictions were ever secured. A government commission investigating the massacre was not established until **1997** — **76 years later**.
